snippet.title: Whatta Frogs? - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Whatta Frogs? is a fast, social deduction party game where bluffing, guessing and messing with your friends is the whole point. Pick a box, fullfill your role and try to read everyone at the table.

Play online with 2–6 players, so bring up your friends!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3762800/Whatta_Frogs/

More info here: https://whattafrogs.carrd.co/
